feat(worktree): PC のツールのペイン（File Tree など）を左右で切り替えられるようにする (#4219)

## 原因（実コードで確認。Issue の見立て「状態の到達を待たずに次へ進む」を具体化）
- src/components/worktree/SearchBar.tsx:166 の mount effect が、Files のペインを開いて約 100ms 後に
  検索欄（data-testid=search-input）へフォーカスを移す（focusin の記録で click 168ms → input 287ms を実測）。
- :34 は click 後に header-tool-files のフォーカスを 1 回読み、Esc を押していた。100ms の移動の前に
  届けば緑、後なら toBeFocused が inactive（11 件）、間なら Esc が検索欄に届き（SearchBar が Esc を
  preventDefault、#3589）ペインが閉じない（toHaveCount(0) が 1、1 件）。失敗時の error-context は全件
  `textbox "Search files" [active]`。
- :85 は btn.focus() の後に同じ移動でフォーカスが外れ、focus で開いていた tooltip が閉じる
  （element not found 5 件・poll 3 件）か、Enter が検索欄に届いて data-side が right のまま（1 件）。
- 「pinned on the left … dragging」は直す途中の実行で 1/80 落ちた（幅 199.03 が < 198.875 にならない）。
  固定した列は transition-[width] で幅が動き、PaneResizer は press の後の effect で listener を付け、
  各 move を最後の render の幅に足す（WorktreeDesktopLayout.handleActivityResize）。
  steps: 5 の連続した move は render より先に届くと差分が失われる。

## 直し方（期待・timeout・retry・skip・workers と src/** は変えない）
- :34 / :85 の Esc・Enter 前の失敗 ← openFilesPane() が click 後に activeElement=search-input を
  expect.poll で待つ（SearchBar の一度きりのフォーカス移動が済んだ状態から始める）
- :34 の Esc 後 ← files.focus() → toBeFocused を確かめてから Esc、閉じた後の document.activeElement を
  expect.poll で待ってから toBeFocused（#3650 の「開いたアイコンから Esc」をそのまま）
- :85 の tooltip not found ← btn.focus() → toBeFocused と移動前の文面の bubble の表示を確かめてから Enter
  （表示の契機の focus が成り立っていること）。Enter の後は data-side=left・ボタンの focus・
  isBoxSettled（2 フレームで box が同じ）を待ってから box を測り、移動後の文面の tooltip を待つ。
  文面が変わったこと（Move to left → Move to right）も確かめる
- pinned のドラッグ ← data-pinned の後に列の box が落ち着くのを待って測る。press の後は body の cursor が
  col-resize（listener を付ける effect と同じ所で設定）になるのを待ち、12px ずつ 5 歩、各歩で幅が減り
  落ち着くのを待つ（合計 60px。原文は中心から r.x-60 まで steps:5）。期待（pane.width-20 未満）は不変
- fixtures/terminal-split-helpers.ts に activeTestId(page)・isBoxSettled(locator) を足した
  （値を返し、expect は spec 側。既存の rectOf 等の流儀）

## 判断
- 原文 :46 の「click の直後に icon がフォーカスを持つ」は、製品が 100ms 後に検索欄へ移すので状態として
  成り立たない（速い時だけ通っていた）。期待（Esc で icon にフォーカスが戻る）を弱めず、Esc の前に
  icon へフォーカスを置き直してから押す形にした。
- 陽性対照＝直す前の版の下の赤（21/80）。陰性対照＝変えていない「the move button flips …」と
  他 3 本の期待はそのまま緑。E2E のため os.tmpdir の対照ファイルは作らない。

## 先に赤（直す前、e067e668a）
npx playwright test tests/e2e/activity-pane-side-4219.spec.ts --repeat-each 20 --retries 0
（既定 workers=14、CM_E2E_PORT=3219 のみ指定）
- 21 failed / 59 passed。loadavg 開始 48.1 53.7 53.5 → 終了 78.4 62.0 56.7（28 コア）
- 内訳: :46 toBeFocused 11、:48 toHaveCount 1、:91 data-side 1、:95 tooltip not found 5、:96 poll 3
  （:34 が 12、:85 が 9）

## 直した後（同じコマンド）
- 途中版（ドラッグ未対応）: 80 passed（load 32.5→75.7）／ 79 passed・1 failed＝pinned のドラッグ
  （load 75.7→78.6）→ 上の通り直した
- 最終版 1 回目: 80 passed・0 failed。loadavg 50.5 62.0 58.8 → 53.7 60.0 58.3
- 最終版 2 回目: 80 passed・0 failed。loadavg 53.7 60.0 58.3 → 68.2 62.4 59.3
- npm run lint・npx tsc --noEmit: exit 0。npx vitest run tests/unit/guards tests/unit/docs: 91 files / 1290 passed

## 対になる場所（探した結果）
- 本文に無い指摘: tests/e2e/activity-pane-overlay-3589.spec.ts:197『Esc on the icon closes a pinned pane too』
  click 後に files.focus()→Escape。SearchBar の 100ms 後のフォーカス移動と競合し、同じ形で落ちうる
  （scope 外のため直さない。activeTestId で search-input を待てば同じ直し方が使える）
- 本文に無い指摘: src/components/worktree/SearchBar.tsx:166 Files を header アイコンから開くと 100ms 後に
  検索欄がフォーカスを取るため、Tooltip.tsx の #3650 の前提（開いたアイコンにフォーカスと bubble が残り、
  そこから Esc で閉じる）が実機でも 100ms 以内しか成り立たない（その後の Esc は検索欄の blur になる）
- 本文に無い指摘: src/components/worktree/WorktreeDesktopLayout.tsx:158 handleActivityResize は render 時の
  幅に差分を足すため、render より速い連続の mousemove で差分が失われる（PaneResizer の
  startPositionRef は毎回進む）。負荷時のドラッグが指に付いてこない
- 見た: header-tools-3591（Git を開いて Esc。Files の SearchBar は無い）、split-header-in-bar-3592・
  worktree-header-one-row-3590・file-maximize-portal-2294（Files を開いた後にアイコンのフォーカスを
  前提にする所は無い）。docs の ja/en・src/cli/types は該当なし。文面の変更なし

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Refs #4219


## 試験から外した期待と、その理由（製品の振る舞い）
- **クリックの直後に Files のアイコンがフォーカスを持つ（:34 の旧 :46）**: 製品の `src/components/worktree/SearchBar.tsx:166` の mount effect が、Files のペインを開いて約 100ms 後に検索欄へフォーカスを移す。速い時だけ通っていた期待で、状態として成り立たない。代わりに、検索欄への移動を待ってからアイコンへフォーカスを置き直し、そこから Esc で閉じてフォーカスが戻る（#3650 の期待）を確かめる
- **高速の連続ドラッグ（pinned の幅の変更）**: `src/components/worktree/WorktreeDesktopLayout.tsx:158` の `handleActivityResize` は render の時の幅に差分を足すので、render より速い連続の mousemove で差分を取りこぼす（製品の不具合の候補、追跡の候補に記録）。試験は各歩で幅の反映を待つ 12px×5 歩に変え、`width < pane.width - 20` の期待は維持

この 2 つ以外の期待（tooltip がボタンの移動に付いていく・Esc でフォーカスが戻る）は弱めていない。timeout の延長・retry・skip・workers の固定・src の変更は無し。

Skills: Remove the ui-workflow skill of an 11.0 prerelease on upgrade

Follows #37296.

## What I did

`storybook upgrade` now removes the `ui-workflow` skill from a project that got it from an 11.0 prerelease.

#37296 split `ui-workflow` into `component-docs`, `write-stories`, `test-stories` and `ui-review`, and left the old skill alone because it was never in a stable release. But `storybookjs/skills` shipped it in every tag from `v11.0.0-alpha.7` to `v11.0.0-beta.1`, and the `skills` CLI does not remove a skill that a newer tag no longer has. So a project that upgrades from one of those prereleases kept `ui-workflow` in `.claude/skills` and `.agents/skills`, next to the four new skills. Its `SKILL.md` tells the agent to run `npx storybook skills ui-workflow`, which now exits with "Unknown skill".

The change:

- `ui-workflow` is in `REMOVED_SKILLS`, next to `stories`, so a refresh runs `skills remove ui-workflow`.
- A refresh that removes `ui-workflow` only updates the section between the markers in `AGENTS.md`. It does not add a removed section back, as it does when it removes `stories`. The prereleases with `stories` had no section yet. Every prerelease with `ui-workflow` wrote one, so a project without it removed it to opt out.

## What this PR does not do

- It adds no message for `npx storybook skills ui-workflow`. The id stays unknown.
- It does not change MIGRATION.md. The section there describes the change from 10.6.

## Checklist for Contributors

### Testing

#### The changes in this PR are covered in the following automated tests:

- [ ] stories
- [x] unit tests
- [ ] integration tests
- [ ] end-to-end tests

#### Manual testing

1. In a project on Storybook `11.0.0-beta.1` with the skills installed, check that `.claude/skills/ui-workflow` exists and that `skills-lock.json` lists `ui-workflow`.
2. Upgrade it to a canary of this PR with `storybook upgrade`.
3. `.claude/skills/ui-workflow` and `.agents/skills/ui-workflow` are gone, and the four new skills are there. `storybook upgrade` installs the skills from the `storybookjs/skills` tag of the running version, which a canary does not have, so the install step warns. To see the removal by itself, run `npx skills@latest remove ui-workflow --yes`, the command this PR runs.
4. Remove the `## Storybook` section from `AGENTS.md` before the upgrade. The upgrade does not add it back.

### Documentation

- [ ] Add or update documentation reflecting your changes
- [ ] If you are deprecating/removing a feature, make sure to update
      [MIGRATION.MD](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md)

test(web): measure the sharing actions of the ticket list until they are laid out (#329)

## Summary

The E2E test *the ticket list › on the narrowest tablet › keeps the sharing actions inside the title cell* read the bounding boxes of the title cell, the Status cell and both sharing actions once. `boundingBox()` neither waits nor retries and returns `null` for an element that is replaced or not laid out yet – the race of `.ai/memory/e2e.md` "Measuring an element" that failed #322 on the tablet in CI.

The boxes are compared with each other, so they are now measured together inside one `toPass()` block: a stale set is measured again as a whole (the pattern of `heightOf()` + `toPass()` from #328). `expectTouchTarget()` still runs first; a `null` box still fails through the existing fallbacks, so the block retries instead of passing. Thresholds and timeouts are unchanged; the dialog-opening part of the test is untouched.

The memory entry "Measuring an element" names this check as a second user of the pattern.

## Validation

- `pnpm --filter @trybun/web exec playwright test --project=tablet --grep "keeps the sharing actions" --repeat-each 20` against the local test environment: 46 passed (40 runs of the test, en + pl).
- Prettier, ESLint and `tsc` of `apps/web` (includes `e2e/`): green.
- Note: the command in the issue, `pnpm e2e -- --project=…`, forwards a literal `--` to Playwright, which then ignores the filters and runs the whole suite – call `playwright test` through `pnpm --filter @trybun/web exec` instead. In that full local run, tests in `accounts.spec.ts` and `product-tours.spec.ts` failed. This PR does not touch those files.

Closes #329

fix(agy): concatenate ACP text chunks as deltas

## Summary

- agy ACP replies lost a repeated character at a chunk boundary: `73-8800` would be shown as `73-800`.
- The agy backend did not set `textChunkMode`, so `AcpMessageHandler` used its default `dedupe`, which treats a suffix/prefix overlap between the buffer and the next chunk as a repeat and drops it. `…73-8` + `800…` loses one `8`.
- agy 1.5.3 streams `agent_message_chunk` as pure deltas, so the backend now sets `textChunkMode: 'delta'` (as the OpenCode and Grok backends do).

## Evidence

Captured over `agy acp` (1.5.3, Gemini 3.8 Flash Low) with prompts that ask for strings containing repeated digits and letter pairs. In both turns, concatenating the `agent_message_chunk` payloads reproduced the model's output exactly, with no cumulative re-sends. Several chunk boundaries fell inside a repeated run (for example a run of one digit split between two chunks), which is exactly where `dedupe` drops a character.

## Test plan

- New `cli/src/agy/utils/agyAcpBackend.test.ts`: asserts the backend passes `textChunkMode: 'delta'` and that chunks split inside repeated runs (such as `…73-8` / `800…`) assemble correctly. All 3 tests fail on main and pass with the fix.
- `bun run typecheck` passes; `bun run test:cli` passes (325 files, 4614 tests).

+
+const constructorCalls: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = []

+    return {
+        ...actual,
+        AcpSdkBackend: vi.fn().mockImplementation(function (
+            this: unknown,
+            opts: Record<string, unknown>
+        ) {
+            constructorCalls.push(opts)
+            return { __opts: opts }
+        })
+    }
+})
+
+import { AcpMessageHandler, type AcpTextChunkMode } from '@/agent/backends/acp'
+import { createAgyAcpBackend } from './agyAcpBackend'
+
+// agy streams agent_message_chunk as pure deltas (verified against agy 1.5.3),
+// so the repeated digit at the chunk boundary must not be read as an overlap.
+function assemble(chunks: string[], textChunkMode: AcpTextChunkMode | undefined): string {
+    const messages: AgentMessage[] = []
+    const handler = new AcpMessageHandler((message) => messages.push(message), { textChunkMode })
+    for (const text of chunks) {
+        handler.handleUpdate({
+            sessionUpdate: 'agent_message_chunk',
+            content: { type: 'text', text }
+        })
+    }
+    handler.flushText()
+    return messages.map((message) => (message.type === 'text' ? message.text : '')).join('')
+}
+
+function configuredMode(): AcpTextChunkMode | undefined {
+    constructorCalls.length = 0
+    createAgyAcpBackend()
+    expect(constructorCalls).toHaveLength(1)
+    return constructorCalls[0]?.textChunkMode as AcpTextChunkMode | undefined
+}
+
+describe('createAgyAcpBackend text chunk assembly', () => {
+    beforeEach(() => {
+        constructorCalls.length = 0
+    })
+
+    it('keeps the repeated 8 when a number is split across chunks', () => {
+        expect(assemble(['Call 73-8', '800 now'], configuredMode())).toBe('Call 73-8800 now')
+    })
+
+    it('keeps repeated characters at chunk boundaries (agy 1.5.3 capture)', () => {
+        expect(assemble(
+            ['73-8800 880', '0 5566 qq rr 3322 ee'],
+            configuredMode()
+        )).toBe('73-8800 8800 5566 qq rr 3322 ee')
+        expect(assemble(
+            ['8800 9999 33322', '2 ababab', ' ab', 'ab'],
+            configuredMode()
+        )).toBe('8800 9999 333222 ababab abab')
+    })
+
+    it('sets the delta text chunk mode explicitly', () => {
+        expect(configuredMode()).toBe('delta')
+    })
+})

fix(web): generate read-state operation ids without crypto.randomUUID

## Problem
When the web app is opened over plain HTTP on a LAN IP (not a secure context), `crypto.randomUUID` is undefined. The read-state enqueue in `sessionLastSeen.ts` called it directly and threw `TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`. No pending read entry was stored and no `PUT /sessions/:id/read-state` was sent, so read sessions kept their unread dot and "mark all as read" failed.

## Fix
Use the existing `randomId()` helper (randomUUID in secure contexts, `getRandomValues` fallback otherwise). The other `crypto.randomUUID` call sites in `web/src` already guard with a `typeof` check.

## Tests
- Added a regression test in `sessionLastSeen.test.ts` with `crypto.randomUUID` removed: `markSessionSeen` no longer throws and the read request is sent. It fails before the fix with the TypeError above and passes after.
- `bun run typecheck` and `bun run test:web` pass.

fix(release): build the go references before ts tests

## Summary
The v0.35.0 publish run (43412190965) failed in `verify`: `go test` and `go vet` passed, but the TS differential suites refuse to skip under CI and `KNOWNS_GO_BIN` was never set in `publish.yml`, so nothing was built or published (npm is still 0.34.1; the release was moved back to draft).

- Add "Build Go reference binaries" before "TS CLI check and unit tests": Go 0.34.1 from this tree (embedding the `ui/dist` built earlier in the job) and the PR #156 head for spec D13, the same way `ts-cli.yml` builds them, exporting `KNOWNS_GO_BIN` and `KNOWNS_GO_PR156_BIN`

After merge, the `v0.35.0` tag is recreated on the new `main` so the `release` event runs this workflow (asset upload and the Homebrew tap only run on that event).

#### Test plan
- [x] Workflow YAML parses; the new run block passes `bash -n`
- [x] Same steps as `ts-cli.yml`, which passes on Linux
- [ ] Publish run for v0.35.0 after merge
benchmarks.solution_diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/publish.yml b/.github/workflows/publish.yml
index 7d68afbf..93114aa0 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/publish.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish.yml
@@ -104,6 +104,21 @@ jobs:
       - name: Run Go vet
         run: go vet ./...
 
+      # The TS differential suites compare against Go builds and refuse to skip under CI, so build
+      # the same references ts-cli.yml does: Go 0.34.1 from this tree (it embeds the ui/dist built
+      # above) and the PR #156 head for spec D13.
+      - name: Build Go reference binaries
+        env:
+          PR156_SHA: 2b3f88d24864f5810c82b935138268f76560ae74
+        run: |
+          go build -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/knowns-go" ./cmd/knowns
+          echo "KNOWNS_GO_BIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/knowns-go" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$PR156_SHA"
+          git worktree add --detach "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr156" "$PR156_SHA"
+          cp -R ui/dist "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr156/ui/"
+          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr156" && go build -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/knowns-go-pr156" ./cmd/knowns)
+          echo "KNOWNS_GO_PR156_BIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/knowns-go-pr156" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
       - name: TS CLI check and unit tests
         working-directory: cli
         run: |

benchmarks.task_description:
fix(infra): make the older running execution case of the deploy test deterministic

- The case aged the running execution by 1 ms from a second clock read
- On a loaded runner more than 1 ms passes between the reads, the running execution becomes the newest and the deploy is skipped
- Reproduced by injecting 3 ms between the two reads: same failure as CI run 43410642036 of #218
- The running execution is now a minute older than the finished one; the injected gap passes
- Test only, no behaviour change

Closes #221
